title: A Letter to Sam

readiness.reading: choosing and reading words to write a letter

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Mrs. Ruth's grandson Sam lives far away in Bellhaven. A letter from the valley would cheer him up.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Choose a word for each coloured space. Tap a line to hear your letter so far.

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.prompt: Write your letter: choose a word for each coloured space.
lines: I live in the valley near your grandma.
My name is on this letter, and I live in the {where}.
This week I {did}, and it was {how}.

feedback.all_good: Your letter is ready to send. Mrs. Ruth will put it in the mail cart to Bellhaven.

outro.speaker: narrator
outro.text: The letter is folded and sealed. It will travel all the way over the hills to Bellhaven.

journal_line: I wrote a letter to Sam in Bellhaven.
unavailable_text: Your letter to Sam is on its way.
